source_user: GPU compute utilization is low while memory bandwidth is near saturation during decode. Explain the diagnosis and next experiments. Scenario variant 110: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: separate weight/KV reads from launch overhead; vary batch, sequence, precision, cache reuse, and kernel; compare roofline-like limits to measured counters.
corrected_answer:
Treat the reported low compute utilization and near-saturated bandwidth in scenario variant 110 as observations, not proof that the workload is memory-bound. Assume model weights, runtime, GPU, clocks, input distribution, tokenizer, sampling, and quality targets are fixed unless a factor is the experimental variable. Label every value and window with units; distinguish DRAM, L2/cache, interconnect, and modeled bandwidth, and separate weight, KV-cache, intermediate, and copy traffic from launch gaps, barriers, synchronization, and failed overlap. The category (troubleshooting) changes the diagnostic emphasis, but not the need to establish causality. A roofline estimate is a bound to test against measured counters, not a diagnosis.

Falsifiable hypothesis: for the suspected dominant mechanism in this variant, the predicted telemetry signature will change in the predicted direction and improve a predeclared endpoint (for example median and p95 time/token or tokens/s) by at least 5% in the affected workload stratum, without violating quality or resource guardrails. A traffic hypothesis requires lower bytes/token and relevant hierarchy traffic; a launch hypothesis requires lower launch/gap time; a synchronization hypothesis requires reduced barrier/wait time and greater measured overlap. Falsify it if the signature is absent, the endpoint does not replicate, the gain occurs only in one unrepresentative stratum, or a guardrail regresses.

After warm-up, randomize repeated runs of a target-only reference, current implementation, and one minimally scoped intervention. Stratify batch size, prompt/decode sequence length, precision, KV-cache reuse, and kernel/fusion choice; hold all other factors constant and use held-out seeds and input lengths. Collect latency distributions (ms/token), throughput (tokens/s), achieved FLOP/s and utilization, DRAM/L2/fabric bytes/s and bytes/token, cache hit/miss data, kernel counts and launch gaps, occupancy/stalls, power, temperature, memory footprint, and output correctness/quality. Record whether counters are sampled or estimated and their uncertainty.

Compare confidence intervals and paired effect sizes, not a single average. Check warm-up, clock/power/thermal throttling, allocator fragmentation, paging, contention, request mix, cache state, compiler variation, instrumentation overhead, and measurement-window alignment as confounders. Do not claim causality when hardware counters are unavailable or mutually inconsistent; require independent trace and counter evidence. Canary the intervention on a small workload slice, enforce latency, error/quality, memory, power, and thermal guardrails, fail closed to the known-good implementation on violation, and retain a reproducible rollback. Domain-expert review and additional evidence are required before treating this provisional result as authoritative.

The category (troubleshooting) changes the diagnostic emphasis, but not the need to establish causality. A roofline estimate is a bound to test against measured counters, not a diagnosis.

Falsifiable hypothesis: for the suspected dominant mechanism in this variant, the predicted telemetry signature will change in the predicted direction and improve a predeclared endpoint (for example median and p95 time/token or tokens/s) by at least 5% in the affected workload stratum, without violating quality or resource guardrails. A traffic hypothesis requires lower bytes/token and relevant hierarchy traffic; a launch hypothesis requires lower launch/gap time; a synchronization hypothesis requires reduced barrier/wait time and greater measured overlap. Falsify it if the signature is absent, the endpoint does not replicate, the gain occurs only in one unrepresentative stratum, or a guardrail regresses.

After warm-up, randomize repeated runs of a target-only reference, current implementation, and one minimally scoped intervention. Stratify batch size, prompt/decode sequence length, precision, KV-cache reuse, and kernel/fusion choice; hold all other factors constant and use held-out seeds and input lengths. Collect latency distributions (ms/token), throughput (tokens/s), achieved FLOP/s and utilization, DRAM/L2/fabric bytes/s and bytes/token, cache hit/miss data, kernel counts and launch gaps, occupancy/stalls, power, temperature, memory footprint, and output correctness/quality. Record whether counters are sampled or estimated and their uncertainty.

Compare confidence intervals and paired effect sizes, not a single average. Check warm-up, clock/power/thermal throttling, allocator fragmentation, paging, contention, request mix, cache state, compiler variation, instrumentation overhead, and measurement-window alignment as confounders. Do not claim causality when hardware counters are unavailable or mutually inconsistent; require independent trace and counter evidence. Canary the intervention on a small workload slice, enforce latency, error/quality, memory, power, and thermal guardrails, fail closed to the known-good implementation on violation, and retain a reproducible rollback. Domain-expert review and additional evidence are required before treating this provisional result as authoritative.

quality_dimensions.coverage: covers diagnosis, mechanism, boundaries, failure modes, measurement plan, assumptions, and safety limits
quality_dimensions.technical_rigor: falsifiable hypothesis with controlled stratified experiment and measured-vs-estimated distinction

risks: Bandwidth saturation may be a proxy or sampled aggregate rather than causal traffic.
Counter availability, cache state, contention, and thermal/clock changes can confound attribution.
A 5% endpoint gain may not generalize across workload strata.
evidence_required: Repeated randomized reference/current/intervention trials with held-out inputs.
Unit-labeled counters/traces linking the hypothesized mechanism to the endpoint.
Quality, correctness, resource, thermal, and rollback evidence plus domain-expert review.
